reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 2 points better, in a game of about 220 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 57 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 192 and 241 total points.

analyst.text: This is Oklahoma City's last NBA Cup group game and they need it: Minnesota were 2-0 in West Group B to the Thunder's 2-1, and OKC have reached the Cup's final four in each of the last two years. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 40 in Friday's win over New Orleans. The stakes lean OKC on motivation, even on their third game in four nights.
